scientific_integrity: Analytic self-contained proof; exact rational finite diagnostics are ancillary, not a certification of infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Real linear isometries; uniform positive cycle gradient weight; integers n>=3. Does not assert results on complex spaces, unequal edge weights, arbitrary graphs, or nonlinear isometries. A broader graph-matroid equivalence could produce implicit prior coverage.
title: Weighted discrete Sobolev isometries of cycles: a unique tetrahedral symmetry point
